Herein, we aimed to determine whether E3 ubiquitin ligase casitas B-lineage lymphoma (Cbl) alleviates endothelial dysfunction in DM rats by JAK2/STAT4 pathway.
A rat model of DM was developed through intraperitoneal injection of streptozotocin
Human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) were cultured in high glucose (HG) condition to induce DM as an in vitro model.
paragraphs: The paper uses diabetes mellitus as the disease context for studying endothelial dysfunction. It models DM in rats and in high-glucose HUVECs, then evaluates whether Cbl alleviates the dysfunction.

paragraphs: The term impaired is used to characterize endothelial function and nitric oxide bioavailability associated with DM. It supplies the background phenotype for the paper's focus on endothelial dysfunction.

paragraphs: Rats provide the in vivo experimental model for DM. The authors induce the model with intraperitoneal streptozotocin and collect aortic tissues to measure Cbl, JAK2, Runx3 and STAT4 expression.
